HexKagune 6.0.1 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server.

**Fixed in 6.0.1**
- Right click works as it always did with Ayato's Steel Blade out and in Kaneki's Full Kakuja: doors, chests, levers, buttons, villager trades, mounting, placing blocks and using items all happen first. The dash only happens when right click would otherwise have done nothing. Nothing in your off hand, so a shield or torch there keeps right click for that item.
- 6.0.1 works with 6.0.0 servers and players.
